mapper.select: SELECT a.attname AS column_name, -- 字段名 col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS column_comment -- 字段注释 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid -- 关联表信息 JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid -- 关联模式信息 WHERE c.relname = #{tableName} -- 表名 AND n.nspname = #{schemaName} -- 模式名 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped;
